title: NFC/RFID: MFRC522 and PN532 modules

spans.text: MFRC522 reads 13.56 MHz RFID/NFC tags; PN532 offers broader NFC features. This sketch detects a card only; it does not authorize access.
MFRC522: UNO SDA/SS→D10, RST→D9, MOSI→D11, MISO→D12, SCK→D13, 3.3V→3.3V, GND→GND. ESP32 SPI pins vary by board.
Install the MFRC522 library in Arduino IDE. Platform: UNO or compatible ESP32 SPI. Do not treat a tag UID as a password; UIDs can be copied.

spans.title: Important safety note
spans.text: Power MFRC522 from 3.3 V; 5 V signals may damage it. A UID alone is not secure authentication.
